name: EXCELLAND ROBOT
summary: Excelland Robotics (Wuxi) Co. Ltd. designs, develops, and manufactures commercial intelligent robots in China. The company offers robotic products, robotic modules, and related service offerings, including robot-as-a-service (RaaS) and rental arrangements. It also develops and offers an integrated technology framework covering vision models, robot decision-making and planning, multi-sensor fusion, positioning and navigation, chassis and motion control, robot domain control systems, cloud-based vision language models (VLMs), cloud data closed-loop platforms, and cloud IoT device ecosystems.
